Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text — the only reason the trailer 138 extinguisher tag appears above is that Jimmy White typed a note about it.

A second limitation specific to tonight: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central on 10/13, so the usual sweep of the following morning for late-arriving submissions could not be run. Any form for 10/13 that lands after midnight is not in these counts, and a few of the absences above may turn out to be late rather than missing.

99 of 99 submissions read. The job board was available — Blake Walton's 10/13/2026 ArkLaTex & Permian Basin boards, received 10:00 AM Central — and the 10-13 sheet of each workbook was used. 63 manned board rows were checked for coverage, 51 on the Permian board and 12 on the ArkLaTex board, after excluding cancelled, rescheduled, standby, WTX-support and days-off rows.
